name: Michael
headline: Turn waipu.tv's viewing data into subscriptions that stay.
saw: Your homepage sells three plans and a Perfect Plus upgrade to every visitor the same way, whether they come for Bundesliga or kids' channels.

Once a viewer is inside the app, what they watch, when they pause and which channels they never open is the strongest signal you have for the next upgrade and the next cancellation. Today that signal sits in analytics, not in the message they receive.
Cross-sell, upsell and anti churn campaigns are built by hand, per segment, per month. The viewer who is about to leave this week gets the same offer as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per viewer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the cancellation before it happens
cases.text: Causal churn signals per household from viewing patterns, pauses and support contacts. The right offer, channel and moment, picked for each viewer and tested continuously.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Upgrade to Perfect Plus when it fits
cases.text: Next best plan and add-on per viewer, triggered by what they actually watch. No more blanket upgrade mails to people on the right plan already.
cases.kpi_label: category subscriptions at an OTT client

cases.head: Keep the catalogue in use, every week
cases.text: Personal content and channel nudges in app, push and email, orchestrated so every viewer sees a reason to open waipu.tv again.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
